applies_to.launch: -p --output-format stream-json; routes sdk (claude-code-sdk rawJson lines) and stdout (raw standard output, C3 and ACCEPT-1)
applies_to.versions: selected through compatibility entry claude-code/stream-json/2.1.299 (inclusive reviewed range 2.1.299 to 2.1.304; tested 2.1.299 sdk, 2.1.303 sdk, 2.1.304 stdout); the compatibility declaration of each source states the selection and its status

executor: journal-ocsf-writer ClaudeStreamMapper (direct Java over the lexically exact Jv tree); one record at a time; state: artifact time fallback only
owner_routing: parent_tool_use_id non-null -> the event is routed to the child core of that tool call (labelled split)

time_policy.reported: timestamp (RFC 3339, ms) on assistant and user records
time_policy.fallback: latest preceding reported time in this artifact; capture start when none precedes

tool_kind_table.note: Name table only. The kind describes the request; no OS effect is asserted.

rules.activity: 1 Partial when message.stop_reason is null, 2 Completed otherwise (rule claude.stream.activity.v1)
rules.usage: message.usage -> usage_observation scope 2 Model response, status 1 Provisional while stop_reason is null (rule claude.stream.usage_status.v1)

rules.status: status_id 1/2 from block.is_error when boolean (Reported); 0 Unknown with basis 3 when absent or null
rules.permission: tool_result_meta[i].permission_decision where tool_result_meta[i].id == block.tool_use_id -> permission_decision scope 1 Tool call, attribution 1 Unique, method 1 Reported identifier
rules.residual: tool_use_result in structured_result; whole record in data of the first result event

rules.usage: usage -> scope 4 Run status 2 Final (rule claude.stream.result_usage.v1); modelUsage[m] -> scope 6 Model status 2 Final with model_ref{name=m, provider_kind=provider, provider_basis 1 Reported}
rules.cost: total_cost_usd -> cost_observation total_cost, currency USD, scope 4 Run, cost_basis = modelUsage[*].costBasis when single model
rules.permission: permission_denials[] -> permission_decisions at scope 4 Run; attribution 1 Unique method 1 Reported identifier with candidates [tool_use_id] when the entry names tool_use_id (observed on 2.1.304), else 3 Unattributed method 2 (none when empty)
rules.status: status_id 1 when subtype == success and is_error == false, else 2 (Reported)

rules.settings: cwd -> working_directory; model -> model; permissionMode -> permission_mode; claude_code_version -> version; tools[] -> tool_names
rules.residual: whole record in data (mcp_servers, agents, skills, plugins, capabilities and the rest stay addressable there)

rules.selector: any line that is blank, not UTF-8, not one JSON object under strict duplicate-key parsing, or cut off by the end of the source
rules.residual: raw_data (text) or raw_bytes_b64 (bytes); parse_status_id 5 Incomplete at source end when the source ended mid-record

rules.selector: a parsed record whose mapper threw
rules.residual: whole record in data; basis names the exception. A defect of the writer is visible, never a lost record

unavailable_at_source: user prompt content (the SDK input is not echoed as a stream record)
final per-response usage and stop_reason (the stream reports stop_reason null and provisional usage on these fixtures; see the transcript contract)

retained_only_families.reviewed: 2026-10-21 (ACCEPT-1): the 2.1.304 stdout stream families with no normalization rule, each with its meaning and the reason it stays retained-only; retention is whole-record under claude.stream.fallback->source_record, so no fact is lost and none is claimed as a portable field

rate_limit_event.meaning: a vendor account rate-limit status snapshot (rate_limit_info: status, resetsAt, rateLimitType, overageStatus, unifiedWindows utilization/resetsAt) emitted by the CLI during the run
rate_limit_event.disposition: retained-only (known meaning); not normalized: it is account state, not an execution fact, usage component or cost of this run; no common concept in the ACP/Spring AI/OTel/Weave/Phoenix mapping catalog; a consumer reads it from data
rate_limit_event.limit: observed on every tested route: 2.1.299 sdk (fixture claude-child-2.1.299), 2.1.303 sdk (pair A inventory) and 2.1.304 stdout (live runs)

system/thinking_tokens.meaning: a vendor running estimate of thinking tokens so far (estimated_tokens, estimated_tokens_delta) emitted before responses
system/thinking_tokens.disposition: retained-only (known meaning); not normalized: an estimate, not a reported usage component; normalizing it as reasoning_tokens would compete with the reported usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens of the assistant and result records, which are normalized (reasoning_tokens)
system/thinking_tokens.limit: observed on every tested route (2.1.299 sdk, 2.1.303 sdk, 2.1.304 stdout); its relation to the reported final thinking_tokens is not specified by the vendor and is not asserted here

user (no tool_result).meaning: a user record whose content carries no tool_result block (the stream does not echo the submitted prompt; such records were not observed on the tested routes)
user (no tool_result).disposition: retained-only; would be the prompt family if a route ever echoed it (UC3-AC13 stays not assessed on the native stream)
user (no tool_result).limit: no occurrence on the tested routes

system (other subtypes).meaning: system records with a subtype other than init and thinking_tokens
system (other subtypes).limit: none observed on the tested routes

system/permission_denied.meaning: a system notification that a permission was denied for a tool call (message, tool_name, tool_use_id), observed on 2.1.304 stdout under --permission-mode default
system/permission_denied.disposition: retained-only (known meaning); not normalized as a decision: the same denial is normalized at tool-call scope from tool_result_meta (decision reject, non_execution_kind user-rejected) and at run scope from permission_denials, which names the call; a third copy would double-count
system/permission_denied.limit: observed once (the ACCEPT-1 denial run); its presence on other permission modes is not asserted

system/task_lifecycle.meaning: system/task_started, task_progress, task_updated, task_notification: sub-agent task lifecycle notifications (task_id, the spawning tool_use_id, subagent_type, description, prompt, status, vendor usage counters)
system/task_lifecycle.disposition: retained-only (known meaning); the child run is represented by owner routing of the child-scope records to its own file; the vendor counters (duration_ms, tool_uses, total_tokens) are never copied into usage observations
system/task_lifecycle.limit: observed on 2.1.299 sdk (fixture) and 2.1.304 stdout (live feature run)
